detail: Per-flowchart htmlLabels=false was insufficient in Mermaid 11.12.0; export contained foreignObject HTML labels. Global htmlLabels=false corrected portability before publication.
The payment diagram text became small at 390 pixels. Shortened labels and a visible unit heading improved the exported diagram.
Three portable accessible SVG exports rendered and visually inspected at normal and narrow widths; source and export hashes verified.
